methods.pivots: 2 left and2 right closed bars; strict left, non-strict right; available after rightmost close
methods.normalization: Consecutive same-kind pivots collapsed to more extreme; simultaneous high+low pivot excluded
methods.structure: Last two normalized confirmed highs and lows: HH+HL up, LH+LL down, otherwise mixed/insufficient
methods.break: First strict close crossing each currently last confirmed pivot; confirmation must precede break bar close
methods.labels: BOS/CHOCH candidates relative to pre-break confirmed swing trend; no universal SMC protected-swing definition claimed
methods.frames: 121 closed M1;24 aligned M5, bounded warmup, no H1 structure
methods.reported_breaks: Last six causal breaks per snapshot; total count retained. Full sequence reproducible from archived raw responses under fixed definition.

limitations: Fixed discovery slice37 scored forecasts; dependent hour clusters; post-hoc no new filter performance.
BOS and CHOCH labels depend on pivot definition, not proof of reversal or executable edge.
After-decision ETH events separated and unavailable at entry.
M5 limited24-bar predecision warmup; H1 structure not available.
